from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(q):
    w,p=q[0],q[1]
    F=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),x,v**p,np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t),x*np.cos(w*t),x*np.sin(w*t)])
    return F
def resid(q):
    F=model(q); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(F,dv_dt,rcond=None); return F@c-dv_dt
bestr=None
for w0 in np.linspace(0.2,0.6,9):
  for p0 in [1,1.5,2]:
